description: This file declares the 'Request' class within the WebSockets::JsonRpc namespace, which is used for handling JSON-RPC request messages in a WebSocket communication context. It includes methods for creating requests, retrieving their ID, and converting them to string, along with internal mechanisms for ID generation.

classes.name: Request
classes.description: A class representing a JSON-RPC request message, capable of creating requests with methods and parameters, generating unique IDs, and converting to string format.

methods.name: ~Request
methods.description: Default destructor for the Request class.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a JSON-RPC request with the specified method and parameters.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the request.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Converts the request to its string representation.

methods.name: generateId
methods.description: Generates a unique ID for the request.
